intent.goal: A team owner can invite a new member by email.
must_happen: A valid invitation creates one pending membership and sends one email.
must_not_happen: A non-owner cannot invite a member.
constraints: Use the existing email provider and authorization path.
assumptions: Invitation links expire after the existing token lifetime.

proof_obligations.claim: Only team owners can create invitations.
proof_obligations.verification: Run authorization integration tests for owner and non-owner roles.

proof_obligations.claim: The main invitation flow works from UI to stored membership.
proof_obligations.verification: Run the invitation end-to-end test against a real test database.
